origin_description: Origin is in pixel coordinates from source image top-left; bottom-center for taller assets.
shadow_description: Shadow is positioned near ground contact; values are defaults and should be reviewed by artists.

placement_contract.footprint_cells: Number of real ground tile columns and rows; separate from PNG pixel size and physics collision.
placement_contract.occupied_cells: Optional exact local mask inside footprint_cells; order irrelevant.
placement_contract.strict_map_policy: strict_v1 requires grid_placement.cell on standalone furniture; existing legacy revisions unchanged
placement_contract.owner_quality_gate: No style approval without native Godot visual comparison.
